plugin_desc: SAF Tehnika Integra microwave transmission SNMP child template (IANA PEN 7571). Select the Integra-B or Integra-W product branch when deploying so only that branch's system scalars are polled. Integra-B and Integra-W OID trees must not be mixed. Private health objects are CPU usage (100 minus idle tenths of percent), memory usage (100 minus free tenths of percent), and CPU temperature in degrees Celsius after dividing tenths by 10. Interface traffic comes from the shared IF-MIB floor. Fan and power-supply state are not collected. Supported brands/models - SAF Tehnika Integra-B and Integra-W microwave transmission devices.
name: Transmission

metrics.name: cpu_usage_percent
metrics.description: CPU utilization of the SAF Tehnika Integra platform as a 0-100 percentage. The device reports idle in tenths of a percent, so usage is 100 minus idle divided by 10.

metrics.name: memory_usage_percent
metrics.description: Memory utilization of the SAF Tehnika Integra platform as a 0-100 percentage. The device reports free memory in tenths of a percent, so usage is 100 minus free divided by 10.

metrics.name: cpu_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: CPU temperature of the SAF Tehnika Integra platform in degrees Celsius. The SNMP scalar reports tenths of a degree, so the query divides the raw value by 10.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
